title: Generative Trajectory Aggregation for Imitation Learning (CarRacing-v2)
summary: A diffusion-based alternative to DAgger that replaces live expert queries with a generative teacher, for robust long-horizon driving.
bullets: Co-developed a diffusion-based alternative to DAgger that replaces online expert queries with a generative teacher trained on offline PPO demonstrations.
Built the end-to-end pipeline — trajectory diffusion modeling, synthetic corrective action generation, and CNN student policy training — for robust visuomotor control.
Achieved 794.4 mean episodic return across 20 evaluation episodes, outperforming standard behavior cloning on long-horizon driving.
